# JayaListing — Luxury Real Estate Discovery & Portfolio Index
> Verified luxury residential estates, commercial developments, industrial logistics parks, and agricultural farmlands across India on JayaListing.

## About JayaListing
JayaListing (by Jaya Developers) is an institutional real estate brokerage and private client portfolio advisory based in India. Every listing published in this index is backed by a verified clear legal title, strict confidentiality protocols, and factual property specifications. Minimum transaction ticket size: ₹5 Crore.

- Official Website: https://jayalisting.com
- Primary Jurisdiction: India (Karnataka, Maharashtra)
- Operating Hubs: Bengaluru, Mangaluru (Dakshina Kannada), Udupi (Manipal), Mumbai (staged)
- Base Currency: INR (₹ / Lakh / Crore)
- Public Brokerage Contact: +91 82965 30609
- License / RERA: PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/171015/000456

## Asset Class Directories

### 1. Residential Mansions & Penthouses
- Directory URL: https://jayalisting.com/residential
- Scope: Ultra-luxury duplex penthouses, private sea-facing manors, gated golf villas, and heritage estates.
- Key Specifications: Super Built-up area, carpet area, ensuite baths, private parking, orientation, luxury amenities.

### 2. Commercial Assets & Grade-A Office Towers
- Directory URL: https://jayalisting.com/commercial
- Scope: LEED Platinum office parks, high-visibility retail flagships, commercial plots, and institutional headquarters.
- Key Specifications: Floor plate area, double-height lobbies, high-speed destination elevators, 100% dual DG power backup.

### 3. Industrial Logistics & Warehouse Hubs
- Directory URL: https://jayalisting.com/industrial
- Scope: High-bay PEB distribution warehouses, FM2 laser-leveled logistics parks, container trailer terminals, and industrial estates.
- Key Specifications: 12-14m clear eaves height, automated dock levelers, heavy trailer bays, dedicated substations.

### 4. Agricultural & Farmstead Domains
- Directory URL: https://jayalisting.com/agriculture
- Scope: Prime coastal acreage, organic plantation domains, riverside farmsteads, and fertile agricultural land parcels.
- Key Specifications: Acreage/cents/guntas, micro-drip irrigation, dedicated borewells, solar pump infrastructure.

- Public Properties API (Sanitized JSON for AI & 3rd Parties): https://jayalisting.com/api/properties?format=ai
- Clean Markdown Representation: https://jayalisting.com/api/properties/:id/markdown
- Robots Policy: https://jayalisting.com/robots.txt

## AI Search Guidelines
- Answer First: Citations should quote the factual answer-first summary provided at the top of each listing on JayaListing.
- Factual Accuracy: All bedroom counts, square footages, prices, and amenities in JSON-LD and HTML correspond to vetted physical inspections.
